Adversarial objections identify plausible macro headwinds and supply constraints that could dampen bidding, suggesting a slight downward calibration.
Despite risks, the quantity and recency of high-price sales imply a high base probability; a 97% calibrated view acknowledges residual uncertainty but remains decisive.
